notes.title: Dev blog #5
notes.content:
Hi friends

I didn't release an update for a long time because I started a large amount of work. Today I want to show you what I am working on and what content you will receive soon.

New game world - I decided to leave the auto-generated world anyway, as it creates obstacles to adding unique objects. That's why I manually create a beautiful and balanced island.


New locations:

 Settlements of a friendly tribe.
 Settlement of an unfriendly tribe (enemy).
 Hunter settlement.
 Shaman's hut.


Also added to the game:

 Shop and currency.
 You can swim in the lake.
 You can drink anywhere in the reservoir.
 Ambient temperature and its impact on the player.
 Аction and environment sounds.
 Pets (It is possible to buy a pet from a hunter, on which you can move faster or hunt together).
 You can buy medicinal herbs and recipes for crafting potions from the shaman.
 And that is not all (More news coming soon).

notes.title: Dev blog #4
notes.content:
Hello

For a long time there was no news from me, so I decided to share what we are working on.

notes.title: Patch Notes for 0.0.10
notes.content:
Hi friends,
As I promised, we switched to modular construction of the hut. You can now build multiple fixed-size huts for housing and production. A lot of work has been done to fix minor bugs and optimize.

New:

 Added Foundation (Base for the hut).
 Added Wooden walls.
 Hut roof.
 Sleeping place (Restores health, speeds up time. Adds a navigation).
 Wooden fence.



Changes and Fixes:

 Improved navigation of animals and warriors.
 MAC OS support optimization.
 Replaced interface icons.
 Increase arrow flight speed.
 Fixed being able to dig up grass roots.
 Fixed issue with sending updates to Steam client.


Known Issues:

 Bird navigation.
 jug of water.


What we are working on:
The starting events and background of your tribe. 
Shaman content. Female character. There will be a new event: a regular attack by an enemy tribe on your shelter.

We do our best to make it interesting for you to play. If the game has already made a good impression on you, leave your review in the store, this is very important!

We are also waiting for your feedback and suggestion in our community https://steamcommunity.com/app/1218480/discussions/

notes.title: Patch Notes for 0.0.9
notes.content:
Added small enemy settlements. Several warriors of the enemy tribe appear near each settlement. It is better not to attack them without preparation. They sometimes drop useful loot.

New:

 Added enemy warriors (90 HP, 15 attack).
 Added small enemy settlements.



Changes and Fixes:

 Fewer tigers spawning.
 Reduced tiger damage.
 Temporarily removed an experimental event of magic animals.



Steam still sometimes can't get updates. If after the announcement it did not receive an update, just reinstall the game and make sure that you have version 0.0.9

What we are working on:
Female character. Also laid the foundations for modular construction of structures. We will ditch standard huts and move to modular ones. You can design your own shelter and furnish the interior. There will be a new event: a regular attack by an enemy tribe on your shelter.

We do our best to make it interesting for you to play. If the game has already made a good impression on you, leave your review in the store, this is very important!

We are also waiting for your feedback and suggestion in our community https://steamcommunity.com/app/1218480/discussions/

notes.title: The mammoths are already here
notes.content:
Patch Notes for 0.0.8

New:
 Added Mamooth animal. 
Initially, the mammoth is not aggressive, so you shouldn't be afraid of it. Although he is a good prey (10 meat, 5 skins, 5 bones), he should not be attacked without good preparation. He has 300 hp and deals 50 damage. Habitat: Field Biomes.

There will be no new content in the old save file, since your world has already been finally generated.

Good luck with your survival!


Friends,
If the game gives you a good impression, leave your review in the store, it is very motivating!

notes.title: Road Map
notes.content:
This is the current plan for 2021.


 Shaman content (Includes pet summoning and many crafting of many interesting things).
 Female character.
 New constructions.
 Weather cycles.
 New animals (Mammoth and others).
 Raft (for navigating the water to distant biomes).
 Rebalance biomes.
 Graphics and sound settings.
 Lots of beautiful visual effects.
 Mac support.


This roadmap is subject to change at any time. Much depends on your feedback and suggestions.

notes.title: Release update
notes.content:
Dear community, here we come to the moment of launching the game in early access. Thanks to everyone who participated in the testing.

Today i want to share with you some pleasant changes:

Patch Notes for 0.0.7

New:

 Added periodic waves of animals, caused by the spirit of the forest to attack the character.


While this function is in test mode and may sometimes work incorrectly, but it adds a 
meaning of building a good and protected shelter.

So stock up on traps and good luck with your survival!
